captions.119-single-file: Four masked men enter the Hive, single file.
captions.120-the-hive-is-watching: Doors close softly as they pass. The Hive is watching.
captions.121-the-shutter: Kaneko sounds the alarm and pulls the shutter down.
captions.124-the-repairman: The radio repairman hears boots in the corridor.
captions.126-dark: Every bulb in the Hive goes out.
captions.127-faces-vanish: Faces at the windows vanish from the beams.
captions.128-by-touch: Vera climbs the black stairwell by touch.
captions.129-she-lets-him: She finds Jack's hand and pulls him up after her.
captions.319-the-unlit-lighter: Her thumb on the lighter's wheel. She doesn't light it.
captions.130-the-roof: A door opens before Vera can knock.
captions.131-she-jumps: Room after room, the Hive opens a way through.
captions.378-the-barbers-shop: The barber turns his chair to the wall.
captions.379-the-laundry: Wet sheets part and close behind them.
captions.380-the-shrine-hatch: A grandmother lifts the altar cloth: a low hatch.
captions.381-the-plank: A plank across the gap, hauled in after them.
captions.382-the-pipe-gallery: The pipes ring softly: one rap means clear.
captions.132-the-gap: Nobody speaks. Every door closes behind them.
captions.132-the-rails-sing: Overhead the rails begin to sing.
captions.133-inches-apart: A train roars over them. Her hand is in his on the rail.
captions.134-the-walkway-is-empty: When the train has passed, the ladder is empty.
captions.135-below-the-viaduct: They step off the last rung into an empty street. Sirens.
